🚀 ultimate-file-manager-pro | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Managing files efficiently across multiple platforms (Android mobile, Android TV, Windows PC) using a dual-pane interface, with advanced features for network and remote access.
✨ Key Features: • Dual-pane file management • Support for Android Mobile, Android TV/Fire TV, and Windows PC • LAN auto-discovery • Remote PC pairing • Multi-protocol network storage access
📖 Summary: Ultimate File Manager Pro is a high-performance, dual-pane file manager for Android Mobile, Android TV, and Windows PC. It focuses on privacy, efficiency, and speed, enabling seamless side-by-side file operations, LAN discovery, remote PC pairing, and multi-protocol network storage access.
